executiveSummary: High-impact exploitation and regulatory responses dominated this cycle. Researchers detailed a phishing-as-a-service operation using AI voice agents to impersonate Apple Support and harvest passcodes and credentials from stolen iPhone victims at global scale, with concentrations in Brazil, South Africa, Indonesia, Italy, India, and Kenya. View Article Law enforcement and elections infrastructure faced direct threats and countermeasures: the FBI warned of AI-generated videos impersonating senior officials to drive victims to spoofed IC3 complaint sites, while Brazil's top electoral court imposed new standards defining political deepfakes after a campaign incident involving an AI-generated endorsement. Security Advisory View Article U.S. reporting linked record consumer scam losses to advances in AI and cryptocurrency, underscoring the financial and social harm from synthetic-media-enabled fraud. Source Separately, the DOJ seized deepfake pornography domains and related cryptocurrency under a new U.S. law, signaling strengthened cross-border enforcement against nonconsensual AI-generated sexual imagery. View Article On the defensive side, provenance and detection developments continued-though evidence suggests audio watermarking can degrade some deepfake detectors-while governments and vendors advanced content labeling and verification capabilities.
